summary_1line: Rishi Kanwa urges Duryodhana to make peace, teaching impermanence and beginning a tale of Matali seeking a worthy husband for his daughter.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the Kuru assembly, the aged sage Kanwa addresses Duryodhana while courtiers listen in tense silence.
Matali gently sniffs the head of his daughter Gunakesi in farewell before descending toward the shadowy nether regions.
Narada and Matali enter Varuna’s radiant underwater realm of gold palaces, blazing weapons, and luminous waters.
